criterion_text: An approved Linux Agent executes a Host-root Pane with a verified EROFS tool visible under its authorized target and an Agent-managed writable Workspace retaining writes across another Pane; failed mount/enter preserves Native and recoverable owned resources.

verifiers.summary: A Linux Host-root Pane mounted a verified toolchain under /opt and a persistent Workspace that kept writes across Panes

evidence.value: Host-root Pane ff152aa0-8087-4f1f-b2c7-af9708f153a0 on linux-bwrap mounted the verified EROFS toolchain at /opt/go
the Agent-managed Workspace retained a write that a second Pane read back
a toolchain source outside the Agent-authorized image root was refused before any mount and the Workspace bytes survived
